searchText: zevm says these blocks are invalid but only because it uses a different sender for these txns and ends up tripping on the witness validation. and it derives the sender by simply hashing the public key. tests should probably modify the signature instead of pk so that the block is only invalid if the guest does signature verification against pk or ecrecover
